Postgres with PostGIS. You chose it because you needed spatial queries—nearest-depot lookups and distance-based filtering—for the ETA prototype. SQLite's spatial support is weak (SpatiaLite extension doesn't load reliably on macOS), while Postgres + PostGIS provides indexed nearest-neighbor queries and geography columns natively.
